about_the_game:
In an era where digital technology redefines reality, we present the absurdity of war through the most incisive lens—an immersive destruction simulator that fuses anti-war philosophy with cutting-edge technology. As Tokyo’s skyscrapers crumble in virtual space, players wield the power to reshape the world, standing at the crossroads of reality and illusion to experience a soul-stirring apocalyptic symphony.

Revolutionary Game Mechanics

Built on high-precision geographic information system (GIS) data and drone-based reality capture technology, the game meticulously reconstructs a 200+ square-kilometer three-dimensional urban landscape of Tokyo. From Ginza’s glass-clad towers to Asakusa’s wooden temples, every scene is powered by advanced physics engines, featuring over 5 million destructible nodes. Players choose from a diverse arsenal—rocket launchers, railguns, and beyond—each weapon boasting unique destructive patterns: thermobaric warheads trigger chain explosions, while antimatter ordnance erases entire neighborhoods from existence.

Immersive Destruction Experience

The proprietary Omni-Destruction System delivers unparalleled interactive feedback. A single missile strike on an office tower sends shockwaves through neighboring blocks, with every inch of Tokyo’s terrain rendered destructible. Paired with a rare 3D-scanned aesthetic, the game achieves an immersive realism rarely seen in the market, blurring the line between virtual and physical.

Innovative Anti-War Storytelling

We deliberately strip away the glorification of combat found in traditional war games, instead using sensory impact to advocate for peace. While demolishing cities in-game offers catharsis, reality tells a different story—each explosion plants seeds of peace in players’ hearts, a stark reminder of war’s true cost.

Technical Breakthroughs

  • Realistic-Scale Urban Modeling: Ultra-detailed reconstruction of Tokyo’s sprawling metropolis.

  • Fully Destructible Environment: Every structure, street, and surface reacts to damage.

  • Dynamic Weather Systems: Natural phenomena like wind, frost, rain, and snow alter the city’s state over time.

In an age where weapons are reduced to playthings, Peaceful Tokyo employs the most extreme digital experimentation to reignite humanity’s reverence for peace. As you press the trigger in-game, listen closely—within the roar of destruction, do you hear the faint whispers of historical scars?
